'''Elisha Merew''' was married to [[Locris]], and they had a young child named [[Jasten (Ganlihk)|Jasten]]. Living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganlihk]], Merew was one of the original settlers of [[Ganlihk Colony 15]].
